title: DevOps, Platform, SRE, Cloud and DevSecOps results
lede: Eligibility is checked before technical scoring. Dice sponsorship labels still require confirmation that TN status and Canada-based work are supported.
latest_update: Updated September 21, 2026 - all six required browser-rendered queries completed; 17 unique first-page results reviewed and 7 relevant remote sponsor-marked roles scored.

rows.title: Salesforce DevOps Architect
rows.gap: Flosum/Copado/Gearset and Apex/LWC depth are requested, but Marc's enterprise Salesforce CI/CD, MuleSoft, and release-governance overlap is exceptionally strong.

rows.title: Cloud Security Engineer - Remote
rows.gap: Strong Azure, Terraform, monitoring, and zero-trust overlap; the biggest gap is dedicated CSPM and hands-on cloud-security ownership.

rows.title: Senior DevOps / Data Platform Engineer
rows.gap: Deep current AWS/S3 data-lake and Fivetran/CDC ownership is central; Marc's AWS work is dated and non-production.

rows.title: Cloud & Application Platform Engineer
rows.location: Remote - W-2; authorization list omits Canada/TN
rows.gap: OpenShift and application-support/platform-operations depth are the largest gaps; TN eligibility also needs confirmation.

rows.title: Forward-Deployed Engineer w/ Generative AI Experience
rows.gap: Azure, CI/CD, observability, and financial-workflow context fit, but production RAG/LLM evaluation and full-stack AI engineering are central requirements Marc cannot yet substantiate.

rows.title: AI Platform Engineer
rows.gap: The role requires eight years of programming and five years architecting large distributed systems plus production AI/agentic systems; Marc's platform background does not clear those depth bars.

rows.title: Senior Google Cloud Architect - GCP & AI Services
rows.gap: Hard mismatch: deep GCP architecture, MLOps, and GenAI leadership are the job, Marc has no GCP experience, and the rate is below his contract floor.

notes_sections.heading: Reconciliation notes
items: The six audits contain 23 result appearances and 17 unique Dice posting IDs after cross-query deduplication.

Seven relevant remote sponsor-marked postings were scored, two on-site TechniPros postings failed the eligibility gate, and eight reviewed results were off-scope application-development, AI/ML, SAP, Salesforce-development, or Oracle-functional noise.
The Kforce Forward Deployed Engineer appeared only in Dice's Similar Jobs module, not in the required filtered query inventory, so it was not counted or scored.
The Quantum Cloud & Application Platform Engineer matches applications.md and remains New; the earlier Dice report incorrectly labeled it Applied.

method: All six mandatory title queries were run independently in a rendered browser with Last 7 Days, Full Time and Contract, Remote, and Willing to sponsor filters visibly active. Counts were 4, 10, 0, 5, 3, and 1; up to eight results per query were audited, producing 23 appearances and 17 unique IDs. Relevant postings were opened, location and authorization were gated before scoring, and pipeline status was reconciled against applications.md.
